q-6673: Correct answer: B. The length of the braking distance is decided above all by grip, and that depends on the type and state of the surface. Reaction time lengthens the stopping distance but not the braking distance itself, and the brake fluid is irrelevant here.
q-6674: Correct answer: B. The distance is chosen so that the combination of vehicles can be stopped before an obstacle, and that is decided by the weather and the type of surface together. Rain, mud or ice lengthen the braking distance, so the distance from the vehicle ahead must then be increased.
